# ANU College of Arts & Social Sciences

> The College of Arts & Social Sciences at ANU offers world-ranked programs spanning undergraduate degrees, master's programs, PhDs, and professional education across arts, humanities, and social sciences disciplines.

CASS is one of ANU's leading colleges, providing comprehensive study options from flexible double degrees to research-focused higher degrees, alongside support services for current students, international applicants, and alumni. The college emphasizes interdisciplinary learning, career development, and global engagement through study tours and international partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Bachelor of Arts
- Master's degrees
- PhD & MPhil
- Flexible Double Degree

## Study Programs

- [Study](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study): Main study programs hub featuring bachelor, master, and PhD options at CASS.
- [Bachelor degrees](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/bachelor-degrees): Undergraduate degree programs including Bachelor of Arts and Criminology options.
- [Flexible Double Degrees](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/fdd): Flexible Double Degree program combining arts with diverse complementary disciplines.
- [Master degrees](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/master-degrees): Master's degree programs including flexible double masters across 20+ disciplines.
- [PhD & MPhil](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/higher-degree-research): Higher Degree by Research programs offering PhD and MPhil with world-class supervision.
- [Graduate Certificates & Diplomas](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/graduate-certificates-diplomas): Postgraduate certificates and diplomas providing career development and Master's pathways.

## Disciplines & Specializations

- [Disciplines](https://cass.anu.edu.au/disciplines): Directory of academic disciplines and subject areas available at CASS.
- [Short courses and executive education](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/short-courses-and-executive-education-arts-humanities-and-social-sciences): Short courses and executive education programs in arts, humanities, and social sciences.
- [Overseas and local study tours](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/overseas-study-tours-and-field-trip-courses): Overseas and local study tours with field trips to Darwin, Alice Springs, and Blue Mountains.

## Student Support & Resources

- [Current students](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/current): Resources and tools for current CASS students including Wattle, ANUHub, and ISIS platforms.
- [Resources for prospective students](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/resources): Guides and resources for prospective students including CASS CAP and postgraduate guides.
- [International students](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/international-students): Information and support for international students including scholarships and accommodation.
- [Student stories](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/student-stories): Student testimonials and experiences across CASS bachelor and master programs.
- [Pathways to other programs](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/degree-transfer-pathways): Program transfer and credit pathways including BPPE and Bachelor of Arts options.

## Career Development & Alumni

- [Your brilliant career – Where can an Arts degree take you?](https://cass.anu.edu.au/study/careers): Career guidance and pathways for Bachelor of Arts and CASS graduates.
- [Alumni & Engagement](https://cass.anu.edu.au/alumni): Alumni network and engagement opportunities for CASS graduates and community.

## College Overview

- [ANU College of Arts & Social Sciences](https://cass.anu.edu.au): Homepage for ANU CASS, showcasing top-ranked programs in arts, humanities, and social sciences.
